verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents a first-party MCP server at its own /domain/mcp page. The server lets an AI assistant check domain availability, register domains, view account info, and review nameservers and DNS records, and a probe confirms the official page exists. The evidence lists capabilities but gives little detail on how an agent actually connects. Missing for 10: documented connection/setup and authentication steps, a full tool list (e.g., DNS write/edit operations, renewals, transfers), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Dynadot MCP is an easier way to manage your domains, just by talking to an AI assistant.It uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Check a domain name availability
*   Register domains for you
*   View your domains and account info
*   Review nameservers and DNS records
official MCP server documented at https://www.dynadot.com/domain/mcp
